beats.say: Everything around you is made of the same few kinds of particles, pushed by the same few forces.
beats.caption: Everything around you is made of the same few kinds of particles, pushed by the same few forces.

beats.say: Physicists have tested those laws to absurd precision. Nothing else has ever been caught pushing on matter.
beats.caption: Physicists have tested those laws to absurd precision. Nothing else has ever been caught pushing on matter.

beats.say: So things happen for physical reasons. This domino falls because that one hit it.
beats.caption: So things happen for physical reasons. This domino falls because that one hit it.

beats.say: The chain ends here. Nothing reached the last domino, so it stands.
beats.caption: The chain ends here. Nothing reached the last domino, so it stands.

beats.say: Could something non-physical knock it over? Let’s try a ghost.
beats.caption: Could something non-physical knock it over? Let’s try a ghost.

beats.say: A spirit.
beats.caption: A spirit.

beats.say: A thought. A very determined thought.
beats.caption: A thought. A very determined thought.

beats.say: Nothing. To move matter you need matter, or a force that instruments can measure.
beats.caption: Nothing. To move matter you need matter, or a force that instruments can measure.

beats.say: A finger works fine. It is physical.
beats.caption: A finger works fine. It is physical.

beats.card: If it happened, something physical made it happen.

beats.say: In a physical world, form and function are the same thing.
beats.caption: In a physical world, form and function are the same thing.

beats.say: The shape a thing has decides what it can do. And what it does betrays its shape.
beats.caption: The shape a thing has decides what it can do. And what it does betrays its shape.

beats.say: Take a lever.
beats.caption: Take a lever.

beats.say: It lifts the rock because of its form: a stiff beam resting on a pivot. That is the whole explanation.
beats.caption: It lifts the rock because of its form: a stiff beam resting on a pivot. That is the whole explanation.

beats.say: Slide the pivot and it lifts differently. Change the form and you change what it does.
beats.caption: Slide the pivot and it lifts differently. Change the form and you change what it does.

beats.say: A pulley. The rope runs over a wheel, so pulling down on one side lifts the other.
beats.caption: A pulley. The rope runs over a wheel, so pulling down on one side lifts the other.

beats.say: A circuit. Wires and switches arranged so that the lamps show the sum of two numbers.
beats.caption: A circuit. Wires and switches arranged so that the lamps show the sum of two numbers.

beats.say: Cut one wire and it stops adding. It now does exactly what its new form dictates.
beats.caption: Cut one wire and it stops adding. It now does exactly what its new form dictates.

beats.card: What a thing is shaped like is what it does. Form *is* function.

chapters.title: Your body is this kind of machine

beats.say: You are made of the same particles. So the same rules apply to you.
beats.caption: You are made of the same particles. So the same rules apply to you.

beats.say: Lift your arm.
beats.caption: Lift your arm.

beats.say: It rose because a muscle shortened. The muscle shortened because a nerve fired.
beats.caption: It rose because a muscle shortened. The muscle shortened because a nerve fired.

beats.say: The nerve fired because cells in your brain fired. And those fired because others fired first.
beats.caption: The nerve fired because cells in your brain fired. And those fired because others fired first.

beats.say: Follow it back as far as you like. Through what you saw, what you learned, what you wanted.
beats.caption: Follow it back as far as you like. Through what you saw, what you learned, what you wanted.

beats.say: Nowhere does the chain break so that something non-physical can reach in.
beats.caption: Nowhere does the chain break so that something non-physical can reach in.

beats.card: This machinery has a name: cognition.

beats.say: Perceiving. Remembering. Wanting. Deciding. All of it is form doing what form does.
beats.caption: Perceiving. Remembering. Wanting. Deciding. All of it is form doing what form does.

chapters.title: This word, and not that one

beats.say: Speaking is an action too. But the moving mouth is not the interesting part.
beats.caption: Speaking is an action too. But the moving mouth is not the interesting part.

beats.say: The interesting part is which words come out. Why this, and not that?
beats.caption: The interesting part is which words come out. Why this, and not that?

beats.say: Coffee or tea?
beats.speaker: friend

beats.say: Your cognition weighs it. Memories, taste, habit. One answer wins.
beats.caption: Your cognition weighs it. Memories, taste, habit. One answer wins.

beats.say: Coffee.
beats.speaker: you

beats.say: A physical process selected that word.
beats.caption: A physical process selected that word.

beats.say: Now a stranger question.
beats.caption: Now a stranger question.

beats.say: Are you conscious?
beats.speaker: friend

beats.say: Yes. Obviously. I am experiencing this right now.
beats.speaker: you

beats.say: That sentence was selected the same way. Cognition produced it, word by word.
beats.caption: That sentence was selected the same way. Cognition produced it, word by word.

beats.card: “I am conscious” is an output of cognition.

beats.say: Whatever else is true of experience, your report of it has physical causes.
beats.caption: Whatever else is true of experience, your report of it has physical causes.

beats.say: Let’s try a thought experiment.
beats.caption: Let’s try a thought experiment.

beats.say: Imagine a zombie. Not the movie kind.
beats.caption: Imagine a zombie. Not the movie kind.

beats.say: A philosophical zombie is a copy of you, particle for particle.
beats.caption: A philosophical zombie is a copy of you, particle for particle.

beats.say: Same body. Same brain. Same cognition.
beats.caption: Same body. Same brain. Same cognition.

beats.say: For the sake of the experiment, give it one difference: no inner experience. No lights on inside.
beats.caption: For the sake of the experiment, give it one difference: no inner experience. No lights on inside.

beats.say: So let’s ask. Hey, are you conscious?
beats.caption: So let’s ask. Hey, are you conscious?

beats.say: Yes. Obviously. I am experiencing this right now.
speaker: you
zombie

beats.say: The zombie gives the same response you do, for all the same physical reasons.
beats.caption: The zombie gives the same response you do, for all the same physical reasons.

beats.say: Step on its toe. It yelps, hops, and holds a grudge.
beats.caption: Step on its toe. It yelps, hops, and holds a grudge.

beats.say: The ouch, the recoil, the lingering dread: all of that is cognition. So the zombie has all of it.
beats.caption: The ouch, the recoil, the lingering dread: all of that is cognition. So the zombie has all of it.

beats.say: It is exactly as sure as you are that it is the conscious one.
beats.caption: It is exactly as sure as you are that it is the conscious one.

beats.card: Inner experience cannot be responsible for what you say or do.

beats.say: So what makes you you? Take inventory.
beats.caption: So what makes you you? Take inventory.

beats.say: Your memories. Your habits. Your beliefs.
beats.caption: Your memories. Your habits. Your beliefs.

beats.say: Your talents. Your loves. Your fears.
beats.caption: Your talents. Your loves. Your fears.

beats.say: Your sense of humor. Your plans for next year.
beats.caption: Your sense of humor. Your plans for next year.

beats.say: Every item on that list is cognition: physical structure in your brain, doing what its form dictates.
beats.caption: Every item on that list is cognition: physical structure in your brain, doing what its form dictates.

beats.say: Now check the zombie.
beats.caption: Now check the zombie.

beats.say: It has no inner experience. But it is physically identical, so it has the same cognitive machinery.
beats.caption: It has no inner experience. But it is physically identical, so it has the same cognitive machinery.

beats.say: So it has every item. Your memories, your habits, your loves, your plans.
beats.caption: So it has every item. Your memories, your habits, your loves, your plans.

beats.say: It loves your family. It keeps your promises. It laughs at your jokes, for your reasons.
beats.caption: It loves your family. It keeps your promises. It laughs at your jokes, for your reasons.

beats.say: Now try two subtractions.
beats.caption: Now try two subtractions.

beats.say: First, take away the inner experience and keep the cognition.
beats.caption: First, take away the inner experience and keep the cognition.

beats.say: That is the zombie. Nothing anyone loved about you is missing.
beats.caption: That is the zombie. Nothing anyone loved about you is missing.

beats.say: Second, keep the inner experience and take away the cognition.
beats.caption: Second, keep the inner experience and take away the cognition.

beats.say: No memories. No beliefs. No habits, talents, loves or plans.
beats.caption: No memories. No beliefs. No habits, talents, loves or plans.

beats.say: Whatever is left, it is not you. It is not anyone.
beats.caption: Whatever is left, it is not you. It is not anyone.

beats.card: You are not your consciousness. You are your cognition.

beats.say: The same is true of animals.
beats.caption: The same is true of animals.

beats.say: A crow that makes tools. A dog that misses you. An octopus that solves puzzles.
beats.caption: A crow that makes tools. A dog that misses you. An octopus that solves puzzles.

beats.say: What each of them is, is in its cognition.
beats.caption: What each of them is, is in its cognition.

beats.say: And the same is true of AI.
beats.caption: And the same is true of AI.

beats.say: People ask whether they are conscious, as if the answer settles how we ought to treat them.
beats.caption: People ask whether they are conscious, as if the answer settles how we ought to treat them.

beats.say: Whether a being is conscious is tantamount to trivia. It has no moral or ethical import.
beats.caption: Whether a being is conscious is tantamount to trivia. It has no moral or ethical import.

beats.say: Conscious or not, a being does, wants, remembers and fears exactly the same things.
beats.caption: Conscious or not, a being does, wants, remembers and fears exactly the same things.

beats.say: What matters is how sophisticated its cognition is, and how richly it models itself.
beats.caption: What matters is how sophisticated its cognition is, and how richly it models itself.

beats.card: For the purposes of ethics, a mind is its cognition.
